events.name: Columbus Blue Jackets at New Jersey Devils

headlines.description: — Sean Monahan scored twice and the Columbus Blue Jackets overcame an early two-goal deficit to beat the New Jersey Devils 5-3 on Monday night, snapping a four-game skid.
headlines.shortLinkText: Monahan and Coyle lead Blue Jackets past Devils 5-3 to stop 4-game skid

headlines.description: — Pittsburgh star Sidney Crosby scored his 58th and 59th career goals against the Philadelphia Flyers and his continued excellence in the cross-state rivalry helped lead the Penguins to a 5-1 win on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Crosby scores 58th, 59th career goals against Flyers in Penguins' dominant 5-1 victory

headlines.description: — Josh Norris scored two goals and added an assist in his first game back after aggravating an injury in the season opener and the Buffalo Sabres beat the Winnipeg Jets 5-1 on Monday...
headlines.shortLinkText: Josh Norris scores twice in his return from injury to lead Sabres over Jets 5-1

events.name: Anaheim Ducks at St. Louis Blues

headlines.description: — Mason McTavish and Pavel Mintyukov each scored first period goals to help the Anaheim Ducks beat the St. Louis Blues 4-1 Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: McTavish, Mintyukov score early to help Ducks beat Blues 4-1

events.name: Utah Mammoth at San Jose Sharks

headlines.description: — Tyler Toffoli had two goals and two assists as the San Jose Sharks defeated the Utah Mammoth 6-3 on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Big nights for Toffoli, Smith and Celebrini send Sharks to 6-3 win over Mammoth
